reason: My hedge thesis works through European defence contractors (Rheinmetall, Hensoldt, Saab, Leonardo) and Ukraine's sovereign eurobonds and GDP warrants. None of the candidates is written on any of those. E38 (Pokrovsk capture) is on the same Donetsk front, so it measures the same battlefield risk as the primary rather than a separate market or political reaction. E59 (Trump-Putin meeting location) and E19 (gold) are only weakly and ambiguously linked to how quickly Kostyantynivka falls, and I would not stand behind a claim tying their outcomes to C1, C2 or C4. So I hold no hedge.
